scope: Independent data audit of five actual new-client response-hold cases using retained old v68 source/inspection/run. No new parser, query, authored run, model or live inference is asserted.
limits: Uses a partial local fixture and recorded actual browser outcomes; this audit does not run the UI or establish universal lifecycle correctness
Old v68 annotations and run receipts are reused exactly; this is not a fresh NLP or query-execution proof
Workspace response programCid is a computed document identity, not an automatic retained-CAS promise
The workspace transport digest is recorded by the browser; only held content digests can independently be recomputed from retained raw bytes here
Native Fit and lcnc:shadow-update observations are source-bound recorded browser signals, not a new execution or proof of an exact wall-time interval
Copied nodes and guarded rent/due syntax remain observations, not positive legal force or class assertions
Source-head preservation compares recorded after-run digests with the original producer manifest; runtime-file readback belongs to the recorder
Fixture outgoing denial is separate evidence; no OS-wide airgap or parser-authority authentication is claimed
negativeControlScope: In-memory copies only; actual proof bytes and old v68 proof files remain unchanged
